src='''def transform(grid):
    """Intersect the non-background cells in the two panels around a solid divider."""
    h = len(grid)
    w = len(grid[0]) if h else 0
    # A solid nonzero row or column separates equal-sized panels.
    for r in range(h):
        if w and grid[r][0] != 0 and all(v == grid[r][0] for v in grid[r]):
            if r == h - r - 1:
                a, b = grid[:r], grid[r + 1:]
                return [[2 if x != 0 and y != 0 else 0 for x, y in zip(ra, rb)]
                        for ra, rb in zip(a, b)]
    for c in range(w):
        v = grid[0][c] if h else 0
        if v != 0 and all(row[c] == v for row in grid):
            if c == w - c - 1:
                return [[2 if grid[r][j] != 0 and grid[r][w - 1 - j] != 0 else 0
                         for j in range(c)] for r in range(h)]
    raise ValueError('No centered solid divider with equal-sized panels')
'''
p.write_text(src)
exec(src,globals())
test=[[0,0,0,3,1,0,3,3,3],[0,3,3,0,1,0,3,3,0],[3,0,3,0,1,0,3,0,3],[3,3,0,0,1,0,3,3,3]]

    """Intersect non-background cells in equal-sized panels around a solid divider."""

    for r in range(h):

                return [[2 if x != 0 and y != 0 else 0 for x, y in zip(ra, rb)]

    # A solid nonzero column separates equal-width panels; compare in reading order.
    for c in range(w):
        v = grid[0][c] if h else 0
        if v != 0 and all(row[c] == v for row in grid):
            if c == w - c - 1:
                return [[2 if grid[r][j] != 0 and grid[r][c + 1 + j] != 0 else 0
                         for j in range(c)] for r in range(h)]
    raise ValueError('No centered solid divider with equal-sized panels')
